google.name: Google Calendar
google.tagline: See your next meeting in the sidebar and get a reminder before it starts.

benefits.sidebar: Your next meeting appears in the sidebar with a Join button.
benefits.reminder: A reminder pops up and rings before it starts.
benefits.channel: Optionally post the reminder in a chat channel, with a link to join.

reconnectHint: Google no longer accepts the saved access. Connect again to resume reminders.

notConfigured.title: Google isn't set up on this server
notConfigured.body: An administrator needs to add the Google client ID and secret first (see the deployment notes in the docs).

reminder.title: Reminders
reminder.leadHint: How long before a meeting the reminder appears.
reminder.bellHint: A pop-up and a sound, and an entry in the bell.
reminder.channelHint: Like a calendar bot: the reminder lands in the channel with a link to join.

meetings.title: Upcoming meetings
meetings.empty: No meetings in the next week.

disconnectBody: Reminders stop and the stored meetings are removed. You can connect again at any time.

toast.denied: Google didn't give access, so nothing was connected.
toast.failed: Couldn't connect Google Calendar. Please try again.

card.label: Next meeting
card.title: Announcement!
card.connectBody: Connect Google Calendar to get a reminder before each one.
